messages:
maya.csm: Heads up — NimbleTech renewal in 7 days. They've asked for a 15% price reduction + want to extend to 18 months. Procurement insists on PO (no card) and requested net60. Legal pasted a data residency/log retention clause we can't accept as-is. Onboarding is ~40% complete; risk if PO delays.
raj.sales: Any levers? We already gave credits last quarter. Can we match 15%?
maya.csm: If we do 15% + 18mo, ACV drops about 12% y/y. They specifically said procurement won't approve unless PO and net60.
jamie.revops: Alternative: offer a one-time onboarding credit to avoid recurring ACV hit. preserves list price.
maya.csm: They indicated ~$25k value needed. Proposal: $20k onboarding credit + keep standard pricing vs a permanent 15% cut.
priya.legal: The clause requests 2yr on-prem log retention and access for audits. That's outside our standard. We need to offer a compromise: limited export for audits, encrypted transfer, and max retention 90 days.
tony.onboard: From onboarding side, main blockers are SSO metadata and final environment scope. If they send IdP today, SSO takes ~3 business days. Sandbox cluster provisioning is 1 day after scope confirmation.
maya.csm: I've asked procurement for their PO template and CC'd finance. They've paused signing until legal signs off.
raj.sales: If legal rejects, fallback to keep them on short-term extension?
jamie.revops: We can offer a 30-day trial/extension under current T&Cs to buy time. Need a provisional invoice to avoid revenue recognition issues. @billing-bot can we create a provisional invoice set to net30 or net60 placeholder?
billing-bot: Provisional invoice created INV-NT-2026-0456 (note: provisional). Link: https://invoices.redwood/INV-NT-2026-0456. Update me if terms/amount need changing.
maya.csm: I'll propose: 30-day extension + $20k one-time onboarding credit. Priya, can you draft legal language for the audit/log request: "encrypted export for audit up to 90 days retention"?
priya.legal: Drafting now, will send to security for technical review. ETA EOD. If security objects, escalate to product for feasibility.
raj.sales: I'm OK with the $20k credit instead of a permanent discount. :thumbsup:
maya.csm: Thanks. I'll update NimbleTech and request IdP metadata. Will log any pushback here.
priya.legal: Draft uploaded to drive and sent to security. Internal link: https://redwood.share/drafts/nimbletech-log-clause
maya.csm: If procurement returns a PO with net60, can revops accept net60 or finance insists on net30?
jamie.revops: Finance prefers net30, but for enterprise we can accept net60 pending credit approval from finance lead. I'll ping finance lead now.
maya.csm: Great. Keeping this thread as the source of truth for approvals and comms.
